scenarios.testName: canonical evidence-review lifecycle authority consequences remain non-authoritative
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Review, admission, lifecycle projection and Recommended Action authority boundaries remain machine-tested
Execution review schema is owner-scoped and migrates cleanly
Lifecycle projection schema is MarkReg-owned and migrates cleanly
Recommended Action schema is MarkReg-owned and migrates cleanly

scenarios.testName: owns and verifies Execution migration 0036 with separate owner databases
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Reviewed-source sender state migrates without cross-service SQL

scenarios.testName: survives receiver response loss and sender/receiver restart replay
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Committed receiver truth and sender delivery converge after process reconstruction without duplicate lifecycle events

scenarios.testName: exact replay and duplicate admission converge idempotently
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Stable idempotency keys cannot create duplicate lifecycle truth
Only one concurrent exact-version review decision becomes authoritative and the loser fails closed
Concurrent deterministic regeneration does not create duplicate Recommended Actions

scenarios.testName: cross-Workspace handoff and lookup fail closed
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Workspace identity remains enforced at both sender and receiver boundaries

scenarios.testName: customer lifecycle surface is redacted and preserves authority language
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Customer UI does not expose internal provider return or fingerprint provenance and does not imply execution authority

scenarios.testName: operations provenance requires review permission while customer reads remain bounded
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Permission, expired-session and Origin/CSRF boundaries fail closed before mutation

scenarios.testName: MarkReg lifecycle surface preserves Workspace and authority boundaries
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Lifecycle and recommendation HTTP transport does not create stronger authority than repositories own

scenarios.testName: Execution provenance surface remains authenticated and review-scoped
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Evidence provenance remains review evidence and does not become customer Official Truth

scenarios.testName: real HTTP/runtime browser golden path passes without route interception
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Authenticated production-built browser path remains operable on desktop without request interception

scenarios.testName: real HTTP/runtime browser golden path also runs at mobile width
scenarios.expectedEvidence: The existing real-runtime browser gate exercises the same path at 390px width

scenarios.testName: critical Execution and MarkReg durable suites run a second cycle on the same owner databases
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Critical migrations and durable semantics are repeatable without leaked test state or one-shot assumptions
